title: Filtered colimit of injective sheaves is Cech-acyclic on a quasi-compact basis
statement: Let X be a topological space whose quasi-compact opens form a basis and whose pairwise intersections of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. Let (I_i) be a filtered diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of injective abelian sheaves and let I = colim_i I_i. For every quasi-compact open U and every finite covering of U by quasi-compact opens with all finite intersections quasi-compact, the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of I on that covering vanishes in every positive degree. Hence H^q(U,I)=0 for q>0, where H^q(U,-)=R^q\Gamma(U,-) is cohomology over the object U of the open site of X [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (for U=X the cohomology of [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]).
